comparison.objective: Hot-tap a live pipe through its valve.
comparison.physical_skill: Valve/tool setup, drilling or cutting through a pressurized pipe, and pressure containment; unlike hammer-driven tang fracture.
comparison.success_condition: A completed live-pipe tap without loss of containment is implied; pressure, leakage, cut-depth, and damage thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Tests pressure-boundary penetration and valve-mediated containment, not small insert finishing and recovery of four loose tangs.
